message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine appropriate criminal charge(s) based on facts. The case: theft of 7 guihua trees (桂花树) from a company's plantation, value 5400 yuan, stolen by group, then planted elsewhere awaiting sale. The defendant Zhang voluntarily surrendered (self-surrender). The prosecution says illegal possession, secret theft, large amount, should be charged. Likely charge: theft (盗窃). Possibly also "非法占有" is part of theft. Could there be "抢夺"? No, they dug and stole, not snatching. So theft.

Also maybe "组织、领导、帮助盗窃"? But Zhang is a participant, not necessarily organizer. The charge is theft. Could also be "破坏财物"? They dug up trees, causing damage to property. But the primary is theft of property (trees). In Chinese criminal law, theft of trees is theft of property. So charge: 盗窃.

Any other? Possibly "自首" is not a charge. So answer: [罪名]盗窃<eoa>.
